notice: Hand check of a real, public record: two files about one subsidized housing deal, posted by Howard County, Maryland. One reader listed every sentence that states a commitment or a term. No second reviewer or housing staff has repeated the check. The PDFs are not in this repository; see manifest.json.

differs.why: The testimony says the homes are restricted for 30 years. The agreement ties the restriction to a 20-year term.

story: Staff testimony and a fiscal memo (proposed, with the Board's recommendation supported), then the resolution the Council adopted with the agreement attached (supported). The attached agreement is the approved form with blank signature blocks, so nothing is signed or delivered.
source: docs/REAL-RECORD.md. That hand check counted 31 statements, 12 in the testimony and 19 in the resolution and agreement, but did not print the full list. This file writes the list out from the same reading of the pages, so a few entries may differ from the first count.

excluded_pages.why: These pages repeat the testimony (43929.pdf) as a scan. Claims kept from them are left out of every score.
An amendment marked "Not introduced" by hand. It has no labeled statement, so a claim kept from this page counts against precision.

also_right_note: Other sentences that state a term of this deal correctly, mostly restatements of a labeled statement. They are not counted for recall. A kept claim that matches one is counted as right, not as an error. Written before the recall work was measured.
